name: SEOAgent
author: Alec Lindsay
summary: Sets up SEOAgent in a website repository, evaluates SEO recommendations, and applies changes with recorded reasons.
starterPrompt: Review this website repository and explain the SEOAgent setup it needs. Propose the first changes and wait for my approval before editing.
usageNote: Requires repository and SEOAgent access. Review permissions and proposed changes; make a backup before allowing edits.
